tx.origin - used for bot detection in AaveHelper/CompoundSaverHelper fee logic and leftover ETH refunds

DSProxyCache.cache - keccak256(code) => deployed target address
Subscription holder array (Compound/Aave/MCD) storing monitored positions

BotRegistry.botList mapping deciding automatic service fee tier

edges.reason: msg.sender is written directly into the privileged owner state variable in the AdminAuth/DSAuth/Savings constructors
msg.sender becomes owner of Migrations and thereby controls the restricted upgrade path that writes last_completed_migration
isAuthorized resolves privileges from the caller address passed as src (msg.sender via auth modifier)
isAuthorized branches on the authority state variable and delegates to authority.canCall
setAuthority writes the DSAuthority instance into the authority state variable
DSAuth.setOwner assigns the new address into the owner state variable
setAdminByOwner guards execution with require(msg.sender == owner)
setOwnerByAdmin lets the admin overwrite the owner state variable
changeMonitor stores now into changeRequestedTimestamp, making rotation miner-influenceable
confirmNewMonitor decides whether rotation may complete by comparing changeRequestedTimestamp plus CHANGE_PERIOD against now
callExecute is gated by onlyMonitor requiring msg.sender equals the monitor state variable
allowed mapping membership governs the onlyAllowed modifier guarding monitor configuration
callExecute forwards attacker-controlled calldata into DSProxy.execute, enabling re-entry into the proxy during monitor flow
Auth.setAuthorized is onlyOwner and toggles the authorized mapping keyed by caller-supplied address
authorized mapping is the storage mutated by setAuthorized granting execution rights
read returns the implementation address stored in the cache mapping
write stores the newly created target into the cache mapping
DSProxyCache.write deploys arbitrary bytecode via inline assembly create
getFee checks BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to select the fee tier, making the fee dependent on the originating EOA
botList mapping drives the automatic vs manual service fee decision
getFee pushes ETH or ERC20 balance to WALLET_ADDR using native transfer/safeTransfer
sendContractBalance transfers contract ETH/tokens to a caller-supplied user address
upgrade casts a caller-supplied address to Migrations and calls setCompleted writing last_completed_migration
callProxy requires onlyAuthorized and validates that the recovered signer equals _user
callProxy invokes DSProxy.execute on an arbitrary proxy with caller-supplied calldata and msg.value
givePermission creates a DSGuard and writes it into DSAuth.authority when no authority exists
removePermission reads and revokes authority entries through the DSGuard stored in the authority slot
givePermission and removePermission are the paired permit/forbid entrypoints for the proxy guard
openLeveragedLoan grants permission then triggers lendingPool.flashLoan with encoded params for the receiver
moveLoan grants permission to the shifter receiver and calls lendingPool.flashLoan re-entering external code
repayWithLoan calls Aave flashLoan on the flash taker contract with externally supplied params
executeOperation is the re-entrant flash loan callback entrypoint of MCDSaverFlashLoan
CompoundImportFlashLoan.executeOperation calls DSProxy.execute on a decoded proxy address during the flash loan
AaveImport.callFunction executes DSProxy.execute calls mid dYdX operation with decoded parameters
takeOrder performs a low level call with value into _exData.exchangeAddr, an externally supplied address
_sell delegates order execution to takeOrder when a 0x price is present
SaverExchange.sell calls _sell after subtracting the DFS fee
AdminAuth.kill invokes selfdestruct(payable(owner)) destroying the contract and sending remaining ETH
kill is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender equals owner
BotRegistry.setBot is onlyOwner and mutates the bot allowlist
setBot writes the bot flag into the botList mapping
Discount.setServiceFee requires msg.sender == owner before writing custom fees
AaveSaverProxy.repay forwards leftover ETH to tx.origin and balances to the proxy owner
AaveSaverProxy.boost sends contract ETH to tx.origin and remaining dest balance to the user
MCDMonitorV2 monitor flow relies on time based ratio decisions executed through the monitor proxy
the owner state variable determines who may call setOwnerByAdmin indirectly through the admin chain
the owner state variable is the sole authority for the kill selfdestruct routine
changeMonitor sets lastMonitor and newMonitor which later overwrite the monitor state variable
setMonitor writes the first monitor into the monitor state variable
confirmNewMonitor assigns newMonitor into the monitor state variable after the waiting period
callProxy requires DSProxyInterface(_proxy).owner() == _user bindings the proxy owner state
calcGasCost output feeds the encoded repay/boost call executed by the monitor proxy
AaveMonitor.repayFor uses calcGasCost to build the gas cost passed into the proxy call
Prices.getExpectedRate performs a low level call into a caller-supplied wrapper address

normalization_plan.reason: owner_ is the sole argument that flows into the owner state write inside DSAuth.setOwner and should be folded into that function node
_admin is the argument persisted into the admin/owner chain during first-time admin initialization and normalizes into that function
_monitor is directly assigned to the monitor state variable inside setMonitor and has no independent semantics
_newMonitor is stored as newMonitor by changeMonitor and is only meaningful within that function
the keccak256(_code) local hash is only used as the cache key inside DSProxyCache.write and collapses into that function node
_contractAddr flows directly into guard.permit inside givePermission and carries no standalone state
_user is the signed subject validated by ecrecover and the nonce mapping inside callProxy, so it normalizes into that function
the EIP712 digest local is computed and consumed entirely within callProxy for signature recovery
_amount is the value passed straight into the native/token transfer performed by sendContractBalance
_code is the bytecode buffer handed to the assembly create inside DSProxyCache.write and merges into that unsafe deployment path
